_comment: Play the showcase (click the TV in the room): a few minutes of everything, in order, starting with a sound check. A step is a show ("show": its id, playing "from"/"to" seconds), a stretch of a film or a cinema demo ("movie" / "trailer": the file, "start"/"end"; no end plays to the end), or a stretch of a song ("song": the file, "start"/"end"), in the visualizer or, with "video": true, its music video. "or" lists stand-ins for a step whose file isn't in the library; a step with nothing available is skipped. "title" and "line" are its caption. The finale card closes it.
